import numpy as np

# Find max DTG peak in 450-800 C range
mask = (temp >= 450) & (temp <= 800)
if not mask.any():
    mask = (temp >= 450)

idx_in_full = np.where(mask)[0][np.argmax(dtg[mask])]
x_peak = temp[idx_in_full]
y_dtg_peak = dtg[idx_in_full]

# Fit linear regression to TG curve around the peak to get slope of tangent
half_win = 15 # Wider window for stable fit
start_idx = max(0, idx_in_full - half_win)
end_idx = min(len(temp), idx_in_full + half_win)

x_fit = temp[start_idx:end_idx]
y_fit = tg_y[start_idx:end_idx]

if len(x_fit) > 1:
    coeffs = np.polyfit(x_fit, y_fit, 1)
    slope = coeffs[0]
    intercept = coeffs[1]
else:
    slope = 0
    intercept = tg_y[idx_in_full]

# Reference baseline: horizontal line at 500 C weight
idx_500 = np.argmin(np.abs(temp - 500))
y_base = tg_y[idx_500]

# Calculate intersection (Extrapolated Onset)
if abs(slope) > 1e-6:
    t_onset = (y_base - intercept) / slope
    
    # Plot tangent line segment

    # Mark the onset vertical line
    ax1.axvline(x=t_onset, color='k', linestyle='-', linewidth=1, ymin=0, ymax=(y_base/100)*0.9) # Adjust ymax if needed, simple vline is safer
